name: Nederlandse Loterij B.V.
note: Parent company of Staatsloterij B.V., Lotto B.V. and TOTO Online B.V. and operator of the Eurojackpot game in the Netherlands. Its shareholders are the Dutch state (Staat der Nederlanden, represented by the Ministry of Finance) plus NOC*NSF and Stichting Aanwending Loterijgelden Nederland; only one shareholder holds voting rights. State co-ownership: a state shareholding alone is not a rating.
